blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate motion prediction is critical for safe autonomous driving, yet even strong forecasters leave residual errors in their multimodal proposals. Existing refiners compress complete proposals or update their segments sequentially, preventing the full proposed future from serving as explicit relational context for correction. We introduce FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic refiner that represents each multimodal proposal as a heterogeneous future graph, with spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and, for joint prediction, other agents future trajectories. Bidirectional temporal edges allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in a single pass, and the updated nodes predict residual coordinate and confidence corrections. Requiring only proposals, scores, and scene context, FutureLift provides a common refinement interface for structurally different forecasting backbones. On Argoverse2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, it consistently improves frozen proposals and outperforms native and specialized refiners across marginal and joint forecasting. On the WOMD motion-prediction leaderboard, FutureLift ranks first in minADE (0.5049m) and minFDE (0.9942m) among the compared standard-input methods, without LiDAR or ensembling, while achieving a competitive 0.4874 Soft mAP.
blocks.zh: 准确的运动预测对安全自主驾驶至关重要,但即使是强势预报员在其多式联运提案中也留下了剩余错误. 现有的精炼厂按顺序压缩完整的提案或更新其部分,防止整个拟议的未来成为明确的纠正关系。 我们介绍了FutureLift, 这是一种骨干不可知的精炼剂,它代表了每一种多式提案,是一种千差万别的未来图,其空间基时间节点与代理历史、地图要素、替代模式以及用于联合预测的其他代理未来轨迹相连。 双向时间边让后期证据在一次通过中修改了更早的段,更新后节点预测了剩余坐标和信心校正. 仅需要建议书,分数,和场景背景,FutureLift为结构上不同的预测主干线提供了一个共同的完善界面. 在Argoverse2和Waymo Open Motion Datas集上,它不断改进被冻结的建议书,并且超越了本地和专门精炼器,跨越边缘和联合预测. 在WOMD运动预测导板上,FutureLift在比照标准输入法中位居minADE(0.5049m)和minFDE(0.9942m)前列,没有LiDAR或综艺,同时实现了有竞争力的0.4874 Soft mAP.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate motion forecasting enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate traffic participants and plan safely. Given agent histories and an HD map, models must represent multiple plausible futures over an extended prediction horizon. Modern methods use vectorized scene representations [ 13 , 4 ] , graph- or attention-based context encoders [ 24 , 21 , 5 ] , and expressive trajectory decoders [ 33 , 10 ] . Yet even strong predictors leave residual displacement and ranking errors in their multimodal proposals.
blocks.zh: 准确的运动预测使自主车辆能够预测交通参与者并安全规划。 鉴于代理人的历史和HD地图,模型必须代表一个广阔的预测前景的多种可能的未来。 现代方法使用矢量化场景表示 [13, 4],以图表或注意力为基础的上下文编码器 [24, 21, 5],以及表达式轨迹解码器 [33, 10]. 然而,即使是强势的预测者也在其多式联运提案中留下了剩余位置和排名错误。

blocks.en: Trajectory refinement can correct such errors without redesigning the underlying predictor. Existing refiners encode trajectory features, retrieve context around selected anchors, or model trajectory–trajectory and trajectory–lane relations [ 32 , 27 ] . However, compressed embeddings, sparse anchors, and pairwise summaries do not spatially instantiate the complete proposed horizon. This is especially limiting for temporal correction: within a causal segment-wise sweep, later evidence cannot revise an earlier segment [ 32 , 10 ] . Iterative relational refiners can revisit predictions [ 27 ] , but require repeated computation and still reason primarily at the trajectory level. We instead argue that the complete proposed future should be explicit before correction, allowing every segment to interact jointly with the map, agent histories, alternative modes, and other predicted agents while exchanging evidence in both temporal directions.
blocks.zh: 轨迹的改进可以纠正这种错误而无需重新设计基本的预测器. 现有精炼器编码了轨迹特征,取回了所选锚周围的上下文,或者模型轨迹 - 轨迹和轨迹 - 轨迹关系 [32, 27]. 然而,被压缩的嵌入物,稀有的锚地,和对接的总结,并没有在空间上即时化出完整的拟议地平线. 这尤其限制了时间矫正:在因果分解过程中,以后的证据不能修改早先的分解[32,10]. 迭代关系精炼器可以重温预测 [27],但需要反复计算,仍然主要在轨迹水平上进行理性. 相反,我们主张,完整的拟议未来在纠正之前应当是明确的,允许每个部分与地图、代理历史、替代模式和其他预测代理人共同互动,同时在两个时间方向上交换证据。

blocks.en: Based on this insight, we introduce FutureLift , a backbone-agnostic refiner that lifts multimodal proposals into bidirectional heterogeneous future graphs, as illustrated in Fig. 1 . FutureLift discretizes each trajectory proposal into spatially grounded temporal nodes connected to agent histories, map elements, alternative modes, and compatible predictions of other agents. This graph represents a hypothetical future scene rather than a compressed trajectory token. A bidirectional graph network refines the complete horizon in one pass and predicts residual coordinate and confidence updates. Requiring only proposal coordinates, scores, and scene context, FutureLift attaches to structurally different backbones without modifying their proposal mechanisms. The same interface supports marginal and coherent joint-world proposals, enabling social future relations only for the latter.
blocks.zh: 基于这一见解,我们引入了FutureLift,这是一个骨干不可知的精炼器,将多式提案提升为双向的多式未来图,如图所示。 1 (英语). FutureLift将每个轨迹提案都转化为空间化的时间节点,这些节点与代理历史、地图要素、替代模式和其他代理物的相容预测相连接。 此图代表了假设的未来场景,而不是被压缩的轨迹标志. 双向图网在一次通过中完善了完整的地平线,并预测了剩余坐标和信心更新. 只要求建议书的坐标,分数,和场景背景,FutureLift在结构上不同的骨干上附着,而不修改其建议书机制. 同样的界面支持边缘和连贯的联合世界建议,只为后者提供社会未来关系。

blocks.en: We evaluate FutureLift on Argoverse 2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset using multiple backbones in marginal and joint settings, including within-backbone comparisons with native and specialized refiners. These experiments test interface compatibility rather than transferring a learned refiner between backbones or datasets: each refiner is trained for its target setting. FutureLift consistently improves the underlying proposals; on the WOMD test set, it achieves 0.5049 minADE and 0.9942 minFDE, the best results among the compared standard-input methods, while maintaining competitive Soft mAP. A separate horizon-resolved analysis on the WOMD validation split shows that backward temporal information flow becomes increasingly beneficial at longer horizons.
blocks.zh: 我们在Argoverse 2和Waymo Open Motion Datas集上利用边际和联合环境下的多根骨干来评价FutureLift,包括后骨内与本土和专门炼油厂的比较. 这些实验测试接口兼容性,而不是在主干线或数据集之间转移一个已学习到的精炼器:每个精炼器都接受了目标设定的培训. FutureLift持续地改进了基础建议;在WOMD测试集上,它实现了0.5049 minADE和0.9942 minFDE,是比较标准输入方法中的最佳结果,同时保持了有竞争力的Soft mAP. 对WOMD验证拆分进行单独的地平线解析分析表明,后向时间信息流动在较长的地平线上越来越有利.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are: • Proposal-to-Future-Graph Lifting: A backbone-agnostic interface transforms multimodal proposals into heterogeneous future graphs for temporal, map, modal, and joint-only social reasoning. • One-Shot Bidirectional Refinement: One fixed-graph pass lets later future context correct earlier errors without repeated causal sweeps. • Interface Compatibility and Temporal-Direction Analysis: Experiments with multiple backbones on two datasets and in marginal and joint tasks establish consistent gains after setting-specific training, while horizon-resolved validation analysis measures how the contribution of backward temporal information changes with prediction horizon.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,我们的主要贡献是: 提升:主干-不可知界面将多式提案转化为时间、地图、模式和联合唯一社会推理的多式未来图表。 • 单向双向 完善: 一个固定的图通让以后的上下文在不重复因果扫描的情况下纠正更早的错误. · 接口兼容性和时间-方向分析:在两个数据集以及边际和联合任务上具有多主干线的实验,在设定特定训练后建立一致的收益,而地平线解析验证分析则衡量落后时间信息的贡献如何随着预测前景而变化.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Structured Representations for Motion Forecasting
blocks.zh: 2.1 用于动议预测的结构化表述

blocks.en: Vectorized representations preserve agent and map geometry without the quantization and computational cost of rasterized scene encodings. VectorNet [ 4 ] represents scene elements as polylines, while LaneGCN [ 13 ] constructs a lane graph with explicit actor–map interactions. Later approaches capture richer relational structure: HDGT [ 9 ] introduces heterogeneous node and edge types, GoRela [ 2 ] uses viewpoint-invariant relative representations, and HoliGraph [ 5 ] retains fine-grained spatial and temporal entities in a heterogeneous scene graph. These representations primarily organize the observed scene from which future trajectories are decoded.
blocks.zh: 矢量化表示保存了剂和地图几何,没有光栅化场景编码的量化和计算成本. VectorNet [4] 代表场景元素为多线,而LaneGCN [13] 则构建有明确演员-映射交互的车道图. 后来的方法捕捉出更丰富的关系结构:HDGT [9] 引入了不同的节点和边缘类型,Gorela [2] 使用视角-不变量的相对表示,而HoliGraph [5] 保留了不同场景图中的细纹空间和时间实体. 这些表述主要组织观测到的场景,从中解码出未来的出轨.

blocks.en: Recent architectures increasingly place relational reasoning in the decoder. Query-centric methods such as MTR [ 19 ] , QCNet [ 33 ] , and DeMo [ 29 ] progressively decode multimodal futures; FutureNet [ 25 ] incorporates predicted future context into joint forecasting; and DONUT [ 10 ] formulates trajectory generation as decoder-only autoregressive modeling. Foresight in Motion [ 16 ] applies bidirectional state-space modeling to trajectory-state queries within a hierarchical end-to-end decoder, while NDPNet [ 7 ] separates near- and distant-horizon decoding and promotes kinematically coherent transitions. In these methods, the future representation is part of a specific forecasting architecture. FutureLift instead operates after proposal generation: it lifts the temporal segments of already generated proposals into a common graph for backbone-independent refinement.
blocks.zh: 近代建筑越来越将关系推理放入解码器. 以查询为中心的方法,如中期审查[19]、QCNet[33]和DeMo[29]逐步解码多式期货;FutureNet[25]将预测的未来背景纳入联合预测;以及DONUT[10]将轨迹生成设定为只可解码的自递式模型。 在Motion [16]中的前瞻将双向状态-空间模型应用到一个分级端到端的解码器内的轨迹-状态查询,而NDPNet [7] 则将近相和相距的解码分离出来并推进动能相通的转换. 在这些方法中,未来的表述是特定预测架构的一部分. FutureLift在提案产生后运作:它将已经生成的提案的时间段提升到一个共同的图表中,以便进行骨干独立完善.

blocks.en: 2.2 Trajectory Refinement
blocks.zh: 2.2 轨迹

blocks.en: Refinement is often integrated into the forecasting decoder. MTR [ 19 ] , for example, repeatedly updates intention queries using local motion information, while QCNet [ 33 ] follows proposal generation with a dedicated refinement stage. Such refiners can exploit backbone features directly, but this coupling makes them difficult to transfer across proposal generators.
blocks.zh: 完善常被整合入预测解码器. 例如,中期审查[19],利用当地动议信息多次更新意向查询,而QCNet[33]则遵循提案生成,并有一个专门的完善阶段. 这种精炼厂可以直接利用骨干特性,但这种结合使它们难以在提案发电机之间转移。

blocks.en: Post-hoc methods provide a clearer interface between proposal generation and correction. SmartRefine [ 32 ] uses scenario-adaptive anchors and local context to recurrently refine trajectory segments, with optional outer iterations for difficult cases. Within a forward sweep, information propagates only from earlier to later segments, while outer iterations repeat the causal refinement process. SRefiner [ 27 ] targets multi-agent refinement by constructing a soft-braid topology over trajectory–trajectory and trajectory–lane relations and iteratively updating joint predictions. Although its paper formulates the initial trajectory representation as an encoding of proposal geometry and agent pose, the released AV2 implementation additionally consumes a precomputed 134-dimensional per-mode embedding exported with each proposal. SRefiner is therefore the closest prior work in combining post-hoc joint refinement with an explicit relational structure, but its released interface is not strictly proposal-only.
blocks.zh: 后荷克方法为提案生成和校正提供了更清晰的界面. SmartRefine [32] 使用情景适应锚地和局部上下文来反复地精炼出轨迹片段,在有困难的情况下可选择外接. 在前向扫描中,信息只从较早的部分传播到后向部分,而外向迭代则重复了因果完善的过程. SRefiner [27] 的目标是通过在轨迹-轨迹-导轨和轨迹-线程关系之上构建一个柔软-布线地貌,并反复更新联合预测,从而改进多剂。 尽管其论文将初始轨迹表示作为提案几何和代理物的编码,但释放的AV2执行还消耗了预先计算出来的每件提案所输出的134维每件嵌入. 因此,SRefiner是前作中最接近的将后热联合改进与明确的关系结构相结合的工作,但其释放的接口严格来说并非只提议.

blocks.en: FutureLift differs in both representation and interface. Every temporal segment of each multimodal proposal becomes a graph node, and bidirectional temporal edges expose the complete horizon during a refinement pass. The refiner reconstructs its scene representation from proposal coordinates, confidence scores, and original scene inputs; it does not require the proposal backbone’s exported embeddings, queries, or intermediate activations.
blocks.zh: FutureLift在代表性和界面上都有所不同. 每个多式联运提案的每一个时间段都成为了图表节点,双向时间边缘在完善通关时暴露出完整的地平线. 精炼器从建议坐标、信心分数和原始场景输入重建其场景代表;它不需要建议主干线出口嵌入、查询或中间活化。

blocks.en: 2.3 Marginal and Joint Motion Forecasting
blocks.zh: 2.3 边际和联合运动预测

blocks.en: Marginal forecasting predicts each agent’s future distribution independently, whereas joint forecasting represents scene-level hypotheses whose agent trajectories are mutually consistent. Many high-performing forecasters focus on marginal prediction [ 33 , 29 ] , while FJMP [ 17 ] , FutureNet [ 25 ] explicitly model multi-agent futures. This distinction constrains relational refinement: equally indexed modes from independent marginal predictions need not describe the same joint world, and connecting them can therefore introduce artificial dependencies.
blocks.zh: 边际预测可以独立预测每个剂的未来分布,而联合预测则代表了场景级假设,其剂轨迹相互一致. 许多高性能预测者注重边际预测[33,29],而FJMP[17],FutureNet[25]则明确模拟多代理期货. 这种区分制约了关系上的完善:从独立的边际预测中得出相同的指数化模式不需要描述同一个联合世界,因此连接它们可以引入人工依赖.

blocks.en: FutureLift preserves this distinction through conditional graph construction. Marginal proposals are refined without cross-agent mode correspondence, whereas scene-consistent joint hypotheses additionally receive social future edges. This design supports both settings without imposing joint semantics on marginal predictions.
blocks.zh: FutureLift通过有条件的图表构造来保持这种区别. 边际建议在不交叉代理模式通信的情况下得到完善,而场景相符合的联合假设则额外得到社会未来边缘. 这种设计支持两种设置,而不将联合语义强加于边际预测.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: FutureLift is a post-hoc refinement module that turns trajectory proposals into an explicit hypothesis of the future scene. Its central operation is lifting : rather than compressing a complete proposal into one latent token, we instantiate its temporal segments as spatially anchored graph nodes. This representation makes the proposal geometry available to map, history, modal, and social reasoning. A single bidirectional graph update then predicts residual corrections to the proposal coordinates and confidence scores. We first formalize the proposal interface, then describe proposal-to-graph lifting, one-shot refinement, and the training objective.
blocks.zh: FutureLift是一个后热精炼模块,将轨迹建议转化为对未来场景的明确假设. 它的中心作用是升起:我们不是将一个完整的提案压缩成一个潜在的符号,而是将其时间段作为空间定位的图表节点。 这种表述方式使得提案几何可以用于地图、历史、模式和社会推理。 单一的双向图表更新后预测对提案坐标和信心分数的剩余更正。 我们首先正式确定提案的界面,然后描述提案对图的提升、一发的改进和培训目标。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: We organize the evaluation around five questions. First, is FutureLift’s proposal-only interface compatible with structurally different forecasting backbones? Second, how does it compare with native and specialized refiners when the proposal backbone is controlled? Third, do the gains hold in marginal and joint prediction and on both Argoverse 2 (AV2) and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset (WOMD) after setting-specific training? Fourth, which relations in the lifted future graph are responsible for the improvement? Fifth, how does the temporal resolution of the lifted graph trade forecasting accuracy against refinement latency? We conclude with representative failure cases; qualitative corrections are provided in Sec. A.8 . Unless otherwise stated, validation results for refiners trained in our study are means over the same three random seeds; metric-wise standard deviations do not exceed 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} . Published comparison rows are marked separately. The seed values and full training protocol are provided in Appendix A .

blocks.en: 4.1 AV2 Marginal Prediction
blocks.zh: 4.1 AV2 边际预测

blocks.en: We first isolate the effect of the refinement module on the AV2 marginal task. We evaluate proposal sets from QCNet [ 33 ] , DenseTNT [ 6 ] , and DONUT [ 10 ] , comparing the proposal-stage output with each available native or specialized refiner. FutureLift and the unrefined or native baselines within each block use the same frozen proposal coordinates and logits. Following its official implementation, SmartRefine additionally receives the corresponding backbone trajectory features. Its QCNet row uses the authors’ matched-checkpoint export rather than our bit-identical proposal file and is marked with † \dagger ; the DenseTNT comparison uses an identical proposal stage. FutureLift replaces rather than follows the native refiner and receives no backbone latent features.

blocks.en: FutureLift improves every metric for all three proposal backbones. Relative to its shared unrefined proposals, it reduces minFDE by 13.8%, 14.9%, and 8.0% on QCNet, DenseTNT, and DONUT, respectively; the corresponding minADE reductions are 18.7%, 25.5%, and 20.1%. Relative to the matched QCNet and identical-stage DenseTNT baselines, SmartRefine reduces minFDE by 3.5% and 4.4% and minADE by 1.5% and 13.5%, respectively. FutureLift’s metrics are respectively 10.7% and 11.0% lower in minFDE and 17.4% and 13.9% lower in minADE than SmartRefine’s. The identical-input FutureLift gains across QCNet, DenseTNT, and DONUT demonstrate compatibility of its proposal-only interface; the specialized-refiner comparisons additionally control the backbone setting but, where marked, not the exact export or input contract.

blocks.en: We next test whether the same proposal-only FutureLift interface is compatible with joint forecasting. blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations and Failure Modes
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制和失败模式

blocks.en: FutureLift inherits important limitations from post-hoc proposal refinement. First, it preserves the number of input modes and predicts residual corrections to their coordinates and scores. It therefore cannot reliably recover a maneuver that is absent from the frozen proposal set, as illustrated in Fig. 3a . Second, the coordinate decoder does not explicitly enforce vehicle dynamics, so aggressive corrections can occasionally produce excessive curvature ( Fig. 3b ). Finally, our evaluation uses open-loop forecasting metrics and does not establish that the observed geometric improvements translate directly to closed-loop planning or safety. These limitations motivate dynamics-aware residual constraints, proposal-diversity mechanisms, and planner-level evaluation.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced FutureLift, a backbone-agnostic trajectory refiner that turns multimodal proposals into explicit heterogeneous future graphs. By representing proposal segments as spatially grounded nodes connected to history, map, modal, and for coherent joint proposals to social context, FutureLift exposes the complete proposed future before correction. Its bidirectional temporal relations allow later evidence to revise earlier segments in one graph pass, while its proposal-only interface supports structurally different forecasting backbones without backbone-specific adaptation. Across Argoverse 2 and WOMD, separately trained FutureLift models improve frozen proposals in marginal and joint forecasting and outperform native and specialized refiners in within-backbone comparisons. On the locally evaluated AV2 test split, FutureLift is competitive with the strongest listed marginal methods and achieves the lowest listed avgMinADE and avgMinFDE in joint prediction. On the WOMD test leaderboard, the single-model FutureLift system ranks first in horizon-averaged minADE and minFDE among the listed entries with valid reported values and achieves the lowest listed 8-second minFDE; it outperforms all listed ensembles on these displacement metrics and exceeds two of the three ensembles on Soft mAP. Component analysis shows that one bidirectional sweep outperforms up to three causal sweeps, with a larger advantage at longer WOMD horizons.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了FutureLift,这是一种骨干不可知的轨迹精炼器,它将多式提案转化为明确的多样化的未来图表。 通过将建议部分作为与历史、地图、模式相连接的空间基节点,以及针对社会环境的一致联合建议,未来自由将揭示整个拟议未来,然后加以更正。 它的双向时间关系允许后期证据在一个图通中修改了更早的段,而其只提议接口则支持结构上不同的预测主干线,而无需针对主干线进行特异性的调整. 在整个Argoverse 2和WOMD中,经过单独培训的FutureLift模型在边际和联合预测中改进了被冻结的提议,并在后骨内比较中超越了本地的和专门的精炼厂。 在本地评价的AV2测试分出时,FutureLift与列出的最强边际方法具有竞争力,并在联合预测中实现了最低的上市avgMinade和avgMinFDE. 在WOMD测试前导板上,单型FutureLift系统在有有效报告值的上市条目中位居地平线平均分分数(minaDE)和分数(minFDE)的首位,并实现了最低的上市8秒分的分数;它在这些置换度量指标上超越了上市的所有综艺,并超过了软相上三个综艺项目中的两个. 构件分析显示,一次双向扫荡超过三次因果扫荡,在较长的WOMD地平线上具有更大的优势.

blocks.en: Our evaluation is limited to offline motion-forecasting benchmarks with HD-map context, so it does not yet establish gains for map-light settings or downstream closed-loop planning. Future work should extend future-graph lifting to less structured scene context and evaluate whether the refined forecasts translate into safer planning decisions under closed-loop interaction.

blocks.en: Argoverse 2 (AV2) contains 199,908 training, 24,988 validation, and 24,984 test scenarios [ 26 ] . Each scenario provides five seconds of history and requires six seconds of prediction at 10 Hz. Models predict the future positions of the scored actors. In marginal forecasting, each actor receives an independently ranked set of trajectories; in joint forecasting, each mode is a coherent scene-level world containing one trajectory per scored actor. All AV2 experiments use K = 6 K=6 modes, while the K = 1 K=1 appendix metrics evaluate the highest-confidence mode.

blocks.en: The Waymo Open Motion Dataset (WOMD) contains 486,995 training, 44,097 validation, and 44,920 test scenarios [ 3 ] . It provides one second of history and an eight-second prediction horizon at 10 Hz, and designates up to eight agents per scenario for evaluation. We use the marginal prediction setting with K = 6 K=6 trajectories per designated agent. The official metrics are computed separately for vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists at evaluation cutoffs of 3, 5, and 8 seconds and then averaged. We additionally retain the per-cutoff validation metrics to test whether refinement gains change with horizon length.

blocks.en: A.3 Training and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: A.3 训练和评价议定书

blocks.en: FutureLift receives frozen proposal coordinates and logits from each backbone and does not access backbone queries, exported embeddings, or intermediate decoder features. Because this interface consists only of trajectories and scores, no backbone-specific architectural adaptation is required, although FutureLift is trained separately for each setting. For marginal experiments, FutureLift replaces the native refinement stage of QCNet or DONUT. For joint experiments, it refines the final proposal sets produced by FJMP, Forecast-MAE, or DONUT. We run the trained comparison refiners from their official repositories using the authors’ released hyperparameters; accordingly, SmartRefine also receives the backbone trajectory features required by its official implementation. The daggered SRefiner results are instead reproduced from the authors’ AV2 evaluation with matched FJMP and Forecast-MAE backbones. While the SRefiner paper defines its initial feature as an encoding of proposal geometry and agent pose, its released AV2 implementation loads both proposal coordinates and a precomputed 134-dimensional per-mode tensor named embeds_final ; this tensor is projected to initialize refinement. Thus, these SRefiner rows neither use our bit-identical proposal files nor satisfy FutureLift’s proposal-only input contract. Except for the explicitly daggered SRefiner rows, refiners compared within a backbone block use the same frozen proposal files, split, preprocessing, K K , evaluator version, and random seeds.
blocks.zh: FutureLift从每个主干接收被冻结的建议书坐标并登录,不访问主干查询,出品嵌入,或中间解码器特性. 由于这个接口仅由轨迹和分数组成,因此不需要针对主干结构的改造,虽然FutureLift是针对每个设置单独训练的. 对于边际实验,FutureLift取代了QCNet或DONUT的原生的完善阶段. 对于联合实验,它完善了由FJMP,预测-MAE或DONUT所出的最后一套建议. 我们使用作者释放的超参数,从官方储存库中运行经过培训的比较精炼器;因此,SmartRefine还获得正式实施所需的主干轨迹。 取而代之的是从作者的AV2评价中复制出匕首的SRefiner结果,并配有FJMP和预测-MAE骨干. 虽然SRefiner将它的初始特征定义为提案几何和代理摆放的编码,但其发布的AV2执行负载既包含提案坐标,也包含一个被命名为嵌入-最终的预先计算出为134维的每个模度的收录器;这个收录器预计将初始化完善. 因此,这些SRefiner行既不使用我们的比特式建议文件,也不满足FutureLift的仅限建议输入合同. 除了有明确匕首的"SRefiner"行外,在主干块内进行比较的精炼剂使用相同的被冷冻的求婚文件,分拆,预处理,K K,评价器版本,以及随机种子.

blocks.en: Future and scene features have dimension d = 128 d=128 , and the default refiner uses two heterogeneous attention layers with eight heads. Each attention block uses pre-LayerNorm, dropout of 0.1 0.1 , and a feed-forward network with hidden dimension 4 ​ d = 512 4d=512 and LeakyReLU activation. We use R = 3 R=3 temporal nodes for the six-second AV2 horizon and R = 4 R=4 for the eight-second WOMD horizon. Map and social neighborhoods are radius-based, keeping the lifted graph sparse as the number of agents grows. We optimize FutureLift with AdamW [ 14 ] using a total batch size of 64. Training lasts 40 epochs: the learning rate is linearly warmed up to 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} during the first epoch and then decayed to zero with a cosine schedule over the remaining 39 epochs. We apply no data augmentation. For every AV2 and WOMD validation experiment trained in our study, we use seeds 42, 1337, and 2026 and report the arithmetic mean over the three runs. The same seeds are used for every comparison refiner that we train; the daggered SRefiner values are published results and are therefore excluded from this seed-averaging statement. Metric-wise standard deviations do not exceed 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} across our validation runs, so we report the means in the main tables and summarize dispersion here rather than appending a deviation to every cell. For each run, we select the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss. This seed averaging applies only to validation-split results. For the official WOMD test submission, we randomly select one of the three trained seeds rather than choosing a model based on test performance.

blocks.en: We evaluate whether repeatedly applying the refinement stage improves over FutureLift’s default single-pass design. Here, J J denotes the number of outer refinement passes and is distinct from the number of attention layers within one pass. For J ≥ 1 J\geq 1 , the winning mode used for supervision is selected after refinement, consistent with the training objective in Sec. 3 ; J = 0 J=0 leaves the initial predictions unrefined.

blocks.en: A single refinement pass provides the best accuracy, reducing minFDE by 11.7% and minADE by 9.3% relative to no refinement. Additional passes increase latency and consistently degrade the spatial metrics, supporting the single-pass design used throughout the paper.
blocks.zh: 单次精细度考核可以提供最好的准确度,比无精细度降低11.7%和9.3%。 额外的通行证增加了延迟度并持续地降解了空间度量衡,从而支持了整个纸张使用的单通道设计.

blocks.zh: A.8 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 4 illustrates representative geometric corrections made by FutureLift on the AV2 validation split. Each scene compares the same trajectory hypothesis before and after refinement. In Fig. 4a , FutureLift reduces lateral drift from the local lane geometry. In Fig. 4b , it better follows a curved lane segment, while Fig. 4c shows the correction of a localized discontinuity in the initial proposal. These examples illustrate the local corrections enabled by proposal-conditioned future-graph reasoning; they do not by themselves establish physical feasibility or closed-loop safety.
blocks.zh: 图4显示了FutureLift在AV2验证分出时所作的有代表性的几何校正. 每个场景在完善前后都比较了相同的轨迹假说. 入法义. 4a,FutureLift减少从地道几何来平向漂移. 在图4b中,它最好遵循曲线道段,而图4c则显示在初始提案中更正了局部不连续性。 这些例子说明了以提案为条件的未来图推理所促成的当地更正;它们本身并不能确立物理可行性或闭路安全。
